'''Broclin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war he worked in the [[Republic base (Labor Valley)|Republic's base]] in the [[Labor Valley]] region of Corellia, and while there wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] and white [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and spoke a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]] to customers. Broclin had no hair, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Masani first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game he serves as a Republic weapons modifications vendor on Corellia.
